card.title: PlayStation 5 Memory (RAM) & Firmware Update Troubleshooting

claims.statement: Firmware update reboot loops or failures can be caused by faulty RAM or SSD controllers.
claims.evidence: Checking RAM modules with a thermal camera or checking for hot RAM modules can identify faulty components.
claims.quote: When you can’t update PS5 and during the update process or after the update it reboots then the cause can be RAM related. Check all ram modules you can use a thermal camera to see the temperature and check if a RAM modul

procedure: Check all RAM modules using a thermal camera to see temperatures.
Identify if any RAM module gets excessively hot.
Reflow or replace the faulty RAM modules or SSD controller if the problem persists.
card.caveats: Ensure you verify other update error causes if thermal imaging shows normal RAM temperatures.
